text_en: Then he said to Moses, “Come up to the Lord , you and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and worship at a distance.
text_cn: 上主以后向梅瑟说：“你和亚郎、纳达布、阿彼胡，以及以色列长老中的七十人到上主那里；你们都在远处跪下朝拜。

text_en: Moses alone shall come near the Lord ; but the others shall not come near, and the people shall not come up with him. ”
text_cn: 然后梅瑟一人要走近上主，别人不可走近；百姓也不准同他上山。”

text_en: Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words that the Lord has spoken we will do. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟下来将上主的一切话和诫命讲述给百姓听，众百姓都同声回答说：“凡上主所吩咐的话，我们全要奉行。”

text_en: And Moses wrote down all the words of the Lord . He rose early in the morning, and built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and set up twelve pillars, corresponding to the twelve tribes of Israel.
text_cn: 梅瑟遂将上主的一切话记录下来。第二天清早，梅瑟在山下立了一座祭坛，又按以色列十二支派立了十二根石柱，

text_en: He sent young men of the people of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed oxen as offerings of well-being to the Lord .
text_cn: 又派了以色列子民的一些青年人去奉献全燔祭，宰杀了牛犊作为献给上主的和平祭。

text_en: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he dashed against the altar.
text_cn: 梅瑟取了一半血，盛在盆中，取了另一半血，洒在祭坛上。

text_en: Then he took the book of the covenant, and read it in the hearing of the people; and they said, “All that the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient. ”
text_cn: 然后拿过约书来，念给百姓听。以后百姓回答说：“凡上主所吩咐的话，我们必听从奉行。”

text_en: Moses took the blood and dashed it on the people, and said, “See the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you in accordance with all these words. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟遂拿血来洒在百姓身上说：“看，这是盟约的血，是上主本着这一切话同你们订立的约。”

text_en: Then Moses and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up,
text_cn: 随后梅瑟、亚郎、纳达布、阿彼胡和以色列长老中的七十人上了山，

text_en: and they saw the God of Israel. Under his feet there was something like a pavement of sapphire stone, like the very heaven for clearness.
text_cn: 看见了以色列的天主，看见在他脚下好像有一块蓝玉作的薄板，光亮似蓝天。

text_en: God did not lay his hand on the chief men of the people of Israel; also they beheld God, and they ate and drank.
text_cn: 他们虽看见了天主，天主却没有下手害以色列的首领们，他们还能吃能喝。

text_en: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and wait there; and I will give you the tablets of stone, with the law and the commandment, which I have written for their instruction. ”
text_cn: 以后上主向梅瑟说：“你上山到我台前，停留在那里，我要将石版，即我为教训百姓所写的法律和诫命交给你。”

text_en: So Moses set out with his assistant Joshua, and Moses went up into the mountain of God.
text_cn: 梅瑟和他的侍从若苏厄起身上天主的山时，

text_en: To the elders he had said, “Wait here for us, until we come to you again; for Aaron and Hur are with you; whoever has a dispute may go to them. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟向长老们说：“你们在这里等候我们回到你们这里。你们有亚郎和胡尔同你们在一起。谁有争讼的事，可到他们那里去。”

text_en: Then Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
text_cn: 梅瑟上了山，云彩就把山遮盖了。

text_en: The glory of the Lord settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days; on the seventh day he called to Moses out of the cloud.
text_cn: 上主的荣耀停在西乃山上，云彩遮盖着山共六天之久，第七天上主从云彩中召叫了梅瑟。

text_en: Now the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like a devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the sight of the people of Israel.
text_cn: 上主的荣耀在以色列子民眼前，好像烈火出现在山顶上。

text_en: Moses entered the cloud, and went up on the mountain. Moses was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights.
text_cn: 梅瑟进入云彩中，上了山；梅瑟在山上停留了四十天，四十夜。
